title: InfluenceNet: Encoding Motif Influence for Interpretable Modeling of Cis-Regulatory Syntax
authors: Hu J; Fetter J; Koes DR; Chikina M
one_liner_zh: 该文提出可解释卷积模型InfluenceNet直接编码基序间影响，预测多能性TF结合并揭示Nanog在DNA上的螺旋周期性寡聚机制，结合MD建模，高度契合TF-DNA互作与AI+物理模拟课题。
abstract: Cis-regulatory elements shape gene expression by recruiting transcription factors (TFs) to DNA motifs, yet how motifs cooperate or compete across distances remains poorly understood. Existing deep learning models predict TF binding with high accuracy but rely on computationally intensive post-hoc analyses to infer regulatory syntax, limiting interpretability and scalability. Here we present InfluenceNet, a transparent convolutional architecture that directly encodes motif influence-a position– and motif-specific profile quantifying how one motif modulates binding at another. Trained on ChIP-nexus data for pluripotency TFs, InfluenceNet achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art models while providing immediate, global interpretability. The learned influence profiles recapitulate known principles of motif syntax, including Oct4-Sox2 pioneering activity and Nanog’s striking 10.5-bp helical periodicity, and reveal a cooperative Nanog-Nanog grammar supported by de novo motif discovery. Integrating these results with structural and molecular-dynamics modeling, we propose that Nanog forms chain-like oligomers on DNA through asymmetric contacts between WRD (tryptophan repeat domain) and DBD (DNA-binding domain) that maintain helical phase alignment. Together, these findings establish InfluenceNet as a general framework for accurate prediction and mechanistic interpretation of cis-regulatory grammar, bridging deep learning and biophysical insight.
abstract_zh: 顺式调控元件通过将转录因子（TFs）招募至DNA基序来塑造基因表达，然而基序如何跨距离协同或竞争仍知之甚少。现有深度学习模型能以高精度预测TF结合，但依赖计算密集型的后验分析来推断调控语法，限制了可解释性和可扩展性。在此，我们提出InfluenceNet，一种透明的卷积架构，直接编码基序影响——一种位置和基序特异的谱图，量化一个基序如何调节另一个基序的结合。基于多能性TFs的ChIP-nexus数据训练，InfluenceNet在实现与最先进模型相当的性能的同时，提供即时、全局的可解释性。学习到的影响谱图重现了基序语法的已知原理，包括Oct4-Sox2的先驱活性和Nanog显著的10.5-bp螺旋周期性，并揭示了由从头基序发现支持的协同Nanog-Nanog语法。将这些结果与结构和分子动力学建模相结合，我们提出Nanog通过WRD（色氨酸重复结构域）和DBD（DNA结合结构域）之间的不对称接触在DNA上形成链状寡聚体，维持螺旋相位对齐。综合这些发现，InfluenceNet确立为准确预测和机制性解读顺式调控语法的通用框架，桥接深度学习与生物物理洞察。
